description: This file defines data structures, function prototypes, and constants related to firmware header management and CRC calculations for Broadcom (bcm) devices. It includes structure definitions for firmware headers, functions for endian conversion, CRC calculation, header construction, and header dumping.

methods.name: reverse_endian32
methods.description: Reverses the endianess of a 32-bit integer, conditionally compiled based on ENDIAN_REVERSE_NEEDED.

methods.name: reverse_endian16
methods.description: Reverses the endianess of a 16-bit integer, conditionally compiled based on ENDIAN_REVERSE_NEEDED.

methods.name: get_file_crc
methods.description: Calculates a CRC for a given file, used for firmware integrity verification.

methods.name: get_hcs
methods.description: Calculates the Header Checksum (HCS) for a firmware header.

methods.name: construct_header
methods.description: Constructs a firmware header with provided parameters, automatically calculating HCS.

methods.name: dump_header
methods.description: Outputs the header information to stdout for debugging or inspection.

methods.name: get_control_info
methods.description: Returns a descriptive string for a control number, indicating its meaning.

methods.name: get_buffer_crc
methods.description: Calculates a CRC for a data buffer, used for data integrity.
